# Atharva Sonar — AI Engineer, Full-Stack Developer & Founder

> Official website of Atharva Sonar (https://atharvasonar.me/), an AI Engineer, Full-Stack
> Developer and founder of Velquix, based in Mumbai, India. He builds AI-powered applications,
> SaaS and fintech products and scalable software with Python, Django, React and LLMs.

## Key facts

- Name: Atharva Sonar (GitHub: atharva-404, X: @atharva_sonar_)
- Roles: AI Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, Founder of Velquix (Velquix Dev, https://www.velquix.dev/)
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Education: B.E. Computer Science & Information Technology, University of Mumbai (2025–2028, current);
  Diploma in Computer Engineering, KCES College of Engineering & Management, Jalgaon (2022–2025)
- Products: SpendDecode (AI personal finance, live) and Velquix Learn (developer roadmaps, live)
- Open to: internships, freelance projects and collaborations across AI, fintech and product
- Velquix is Atharva's product initiative; it is a separate entity from Atharva and from each product.

## Project case studies

Each page covers the problem, how it works, architecture, tech stack, engineering decisions and status.

### SpendDecode — AI personal finance platform (flagship)
Case study: https://atharvasonar.me/projects/spenddecode/
Live: https://spenddecode.velquix.dev/ (free plan available)
Upload a bank or UPI statement to get a financial health score, spending patterns, savings goals and
an AI financial coach. Tech: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, React (Vite), Supabase, LangChain.

### Velquix Learn — developer roadmaps platform
Case study: https://atharvasonar.me/projects/velquix-learn/
Live: https://learn.velquix.dev/
Curated free resources organised as career path → roadmap → stage → module → resource, with practice
projects and progress tracking (streaks, XP, badges). Tech: Next.js, React.

### ClaimBlitz — multi-agent medical claim processing (OFFGRID 1.0)
Case study: https://atharvasonar.me/projects/claimblitz/
Demo: https://claimbitz.vercel.app/ (branded "ClaimBitz") | Source: https://github.com/atharva-404/ClaimBlitz
Nine agents (scanner, OCR, validator, medical, policy, fraud, risk, judge, communication) with debate,
voting and human escalation below 80% confidence. Tech: Python, FastAPI, React, Groq LLM, MongoDB,
Pinecone, Redis, Celery.

### SafeHer AI — AI personal safety platform (Build And Grow: AI Hackathon 2.0)
Case study: https://atharvasonar.me/projects/safeher-ai/
Demo: https://safeher-ai-five.vercel.app/ | Source: https://github.com/atharva-404/safeher-ai
Live tracking, scikit-learn risk scoring, voice SOS keyword detection, threshold-based agentic
responses, safe routes. Tech: TypeScript, React, Vite, Django, Django REST Framework, scikit-learn.

### FitHub Gym — AI gym management app
Case study: https://atharvasonar.me/projects/fithub-gym/
Source: https://github.com/atharva-404/Fitness-Hub-AI-Powered-Web-App
Memberships, payments, trainer panel, chatbot and an OpenCV + MediaPipe AI trainer that tracks reps.
Tech: Python, Django, Django Channels, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Razorpay, OpenAI API.
